# lean-pkg-extract

Plan a standalone public Lean-verification repository from a mixed working repository, with exact provenance. Read-only; no registry, no network.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg-extract COMMAND
```

## Subcommands

- [`lean-pkg-extract plan`](lean-pkg-extract.md): dry run: classify, check and inventory what an extract at COMMIT would contain
- [`lean-pkg-extract ledger`](lean-pkg-extract.md): record an extraction ledger: a hand-ported target compared, declaration by declaration, with the source at COMMIT
- [`lean-pkg-extract recheck`](lean-pkg-extract.md): re-verify an extraction ledger against the source and the target
- [`lean-pkg-extract decls`](lean-pkg-extract.md): write the target modules of a declaration-level extraction (optionally a whole package) and record its extraction ledger

## More from --help

```text
examples:
  lean-pkg-extract plan --repo . --commit HEAD --manifest extract.json
  lean-pkg-extract plan --repo ~/paper --commit 0123abc --manifest extract.json --json
  lean-pkg-extract plan --repo . --commit v1.0 --manifest extract.json --report ../extract-plan.json
  lean-pkg-extract ledger @ledger-args.txt
  lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger ../newlib-ledger.json --repo . --target ../newlib
  lean-pkg-extract decls @decls-args.txt --output ../newlib --scaffold newlib --ledger ../newlib-ledger.json

Dry run only: `plan` reads git objects at COMMIT and writes nothing (--report PATH, outside SRC, is the
one exception). The file-level `write --output DIR` step comes next. `ledger` writes only its ledger,
outside SRC and the target; `recheck` writes nothing; `decls` writes the target modules into a new
directory outside SRC (staged, scanned with public-safety, moved into place) and its ledger.
exit codes: 0 plan clean, 1 refused (every reason listed), 2 usage.
docs: https://lean-pkg.github.io/lean-pkg/extract.html
```

## Details

See also `lean-pkg-extract plan --repo SRC --commit COMMIT --manifest PATH`, a separate console script that plans a public Lean-verification repository from a mixed working repository, read-only and registry-free: [Extracting a public Lean repository](../extract.md).

`lean-pkg-extract ledger` and `lean-pkg-extract recheck` record and re-verify a declaration-level extraction ledger (`lean-pkg-extract-ledger/1`) for a library ported by hand from private modules: [Declaration-level extraction ledger](../extract.md#declaration-level-extraction-ledger). With `--method types` they compare the elaborated types too (`types/1`): `--emit-script DIR` writes two Lean programs to run in the source and target checkouts, and `--from-output` reads their outputs back ([The comparison `types/1`](../extract.md#the-comparison-types1)).

`lean-pkg-extract decls` writes the target modules from the same map into a new directory (with `--scaffold NAME`, a whole package: pins copied from the source commit, `git init`, nothing committed), staged beside it and scanned with public-safety before it is moved into place, and records the ledger of what it wrote: [Writing the target modules](../extract.md#writing-the-target-modules-decls).

## lean-pkg-extract plan

dry run: classify, check and inventory what an extract at COMMIT would contain.

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg-extract plan --repo SRC --commit COMMIT --manifest PATH [--json]
                      [--report PATH]
```

Dry run: classify every file under the manifest's roots at COMMIT (default deny), check paths, links, pins, dependencies, claims and imports, and print the inventory. Writes nothing.

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--repo SRC` | the source git repository (its top directory). Required. |
| `--commit COMMIT` | the source commit; recorded as a full SHA. Required. |
| `--manifest PATH` | the extract manifest, strict JSON, schema lean-pkg-extract/1. Required. |
| `--json` | JSON on stdout (schema lean-pkg-extract-plan/1) |
| `--report PATH` | also write the JSON plan (with the private excluded list) to PATH, outside SRC |

### Examples

Classify every file under the manifest's roots at the commit (default deny), check pins, modules, claims and imports from git objects only, and print the inventory; writes nothing, exit 1 with every refusal listed.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract plan --repo . --commit HEAD --manifest extract.json
```

Sample output:

```text
plan: REFUSED (1 refusal(s)): 16 file(s) included (25095 bytes), 0 excluded, 0 allowed private, 4 module(s), 0 claim(s), 0 weakening(s); source commit d3cb7c86cccc608017c2dc944db57931d6007409
refusals:
  - verify.sh: unclassified in a lean-package root (default deny); exclude it, move it, or put it in a root whose kind carries it
included (to <- from, size, sha256, blob, mode, class):
  ...
modules (module -> file, library):
  MyProof.Axioms -> MyProof/Axioms.lean  (MyProof)
  ...
plan: REFUSED (1 refusal(s)): 16 file(s) included (25095 bytes), 0 excluded, 0 allowed private, 4 module(s), 0 claim(s), 0 weakening(s); source commit d3cb7c86cccc608017c2dc944db57931d6007409
```

The same at a tag, also writing the JSON plan (with the private excluded list) to a path outside the source repository, its one write.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract plan --repo . --commit v1.0 --manifest extract.json --report ../extract-plan.json
```

## lean-pkg-extract ledger

record an extraction ledger: a hand-ported target compared, declaration by declaration, with the source at COMMIT.

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg-extract ledger --repo SRC --commit COMMIT --target TDIR [--target-commit T]
                        --from-module SRC/Path.lean:New.Module
                        [--namespace OLD.Ns=NEW.Ns] [--rename OLD.qual=NEW.qual]
                        [--drop OLD.qual:REASON] [--new NEW.qual:REASON]
                        [--allow-differs OLD.qual:REASON] [--ledger PATH]
                        [--method {text,types}] [--emit-script DIR]
                        [--from-output OUT [OUT ...]] [--json]
```

Compare the target modules at TARGET_COMMIT with the source modules at COMMIT, declaration by declaration (method text/1: comments stripped, the namespace and rename maps applied, normalized text hashed), and, when nothing fails, write the ledger (lean-pkg-extract-ledger/1) to --ledger PATH, once. Reads git objects only; writes nothing else. --method types adds the elaborated types (types/1) in two steps, since lean-pkg runs no Lean: --emit-script writes two Lean programs, and --from-output reads what they printed.

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--repo SRC` | the source git repository (its top directory). Required. |
| `--commit COMMIT` | the source commit; recorded as a full SHA. Required. |
| `--target TDIR` | the target git repository (its top directory). Required. |
| `--target-commit T` | the target commit (default: HEAD) |
| `--from-module SRC/Path.lean:New.Module` | a source module and the target module it was ported to (repeatable, at least one). Required. |
| `--namespace OLD.Ns=NEW.Ns` | a namespace prefix map (repeatable; the longest prefix wins) |
| `--rename OLD.qual=NEW.qual` | a declaration renamed, fully qualified (repeatable; takes precedence over --namespace) |
| `--drop OLD.qual:REASON` | a source declaration left out of the target on purpose, with a one-line reason |
| `--new NEW.qual:REASON` | a target declaration with no source counterpart, declared, with a one-line reason |
| `--allow-differs OLD.qual:REASON` | a disclosed difference, counted as weakened (context@&lt;source module&gt; for a module's context rows) |
| `--ledger PATH` | where to write the ledger: a new file outside SRC and outside the target (required, except with --emit-script) |
| `--method {text,types}` | the comparison method: text (text/1, the default) or types (types/1: also the elaborated types, through --emit-script and --from-output). Choices: `text`, `types`. |
| `--emit-script DIR` | method types/1, step 1: write the Lean programs DIR/source.lean and DIR/target.lean (DIR new, outside SRC and the target) and nothing else; run each in its checkout with `lake env lean --run` and keep its stdout (--ledger is not needed) |
| `--from-output OUT [OUT ...]` | method types/1, step 2: the two programs' outputs (source and target, any order), read strictly and bound to this ledger's commits and programs |
| `--json` | JSON on stdout: the ledger plus refusals, failures and written (and programs, with --emit-script) |

### More from --help

```text
examples:
  lean-pkg-extract ledger --repo ~/paper --commit HEAD --target ~/newlib \
      --from-module Paper/Bounds.lean:NewLib.Bounds --namespace Paper.Bounds=NewLib.Bounds \
      --rename Paper.Bounds.main=NewLib.Bounds.main_bound --drop 'Paper.Bounds.scratch:exploration only' \
      --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json
  lean-pkg-extract ledger @ledger-args.txt --json
  lean-pkg-extract ledger @ledger-args.txt --method types --emit-script ~/ledgers/newlib-types
  lean-pkg-extract ledger @ledger-args.txt --method types --from-output source.out target.out

@ARGSFILE: one argument per line; a line `--flag value` is the flag and the rest of the line (so a reason
may hold spaces); blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
exit codes: 0 every declaration accounted for (ledger written; with --emit-script: the programs written),
1 refused or failing (nothing written), 2 usage.
docs: https://lean-pkg.github.io/lean-pkg/extract.html#declaration-level-extraction-ledger
```

### Examples

Compare the hand-ported module New.A at the target's HEAD with Src/A.lean at the source commit, declaration by declaration (method text/1), and write the private extraction ledger once, outside both repositories; exit 1 with nothing written when a declaration is MISSING, an undeclared NEW or a DIFFERS not allowed.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract ledger --repo ~/paper --commit HEAD --target ~/newlib --from-module Src/A.lean:New.A --namespace Old.A=New.A --rename Old.A.foo=New.A.bar --drop 'Old.A.aux:exploration only, never used' --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json
```

Sample output:

```text
ledger: OK (text/1): 4 identical, 1 dropped, 0 differs, 0 new, 0 missing, 0 weakened; 1 context row(s) (0 differ); 0 warning(s); source 0034dfa7d81c09810ac5fce559088d62d0f84b3d, target 395069d8463ef9217daa068b9908d5972692afcc; written to ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json
entries (PRIVATE: source names and paths; keep this list out of anything published):
  IDENTICAL theorem   Old.A.foo -> New.A.bar
  DROPPED   lemma     Old.A.aux -> New.A.aux  (dropped: exploration only, never used)
  ...
ledger: OK (text/1): 4 identical, 1 dropped, 0 differs, 0 new, 0 missing, 0 weakened; 1 context row(s) (0 differ); 0 warning(s); source 0034dfa7d81c09810ac5fce559088d62d0f84b3d, target 395069d8463ef9217daa068b9908d5972692afcc; written to ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json
```

Method types/1, step 1 - write the two Lean programs (source.lean, target.lean) that print the elaborated types of the compared declarations; nothing else is written and lean-pkg runs no Lean. Run each in its checkout at the compared commit with lake env lean --run, after lake build.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract ledger --repo ~/paper --commit HEAD --target ~/newlib --from-module Src/A.lean:New.A --namespace Old.A=New.A --rename Old.A.foo=New.A.bar --drop 'Old.A.aux:exploration only, never used' --method types --emit-script ~/ledgers/newlib-types
```

Step 2 - read both outputs back (bound to the commits and the programs' hashes) and write the ledger with method types/1; a text DIFFERS whose types are equal shows as DIFFERS (types equal) and no longer fails for a statement.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract ledger --repo ~/paper --commit HEAD --target ~/newlib --from-module Src/A.lean:New.A --namespace Old.A=New.A --rename Old.A.foo=New.A.bar --drop 'Old.A.aux:exploration only, never used' --method types --from-output source.out target.out --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-2.json
```

## lean-pkg-extract recheck

re-verify an extraction ledger against the source and the target.

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger PATH --repo SRC --target TDIR [--commit COMMIT]
                         [--target-commit T] [--emit-script DIR]
                         [--from-output OUT [OUT ...]] [--json]
```

Read a ledger strictly and recompute it from its own recorded map. At the recorded commits every field must match; at a newer --commit or --target-commit nothing may fail, and what changed is listed as drift. Writes nothing. A types/1 ledger needs --from-output (its programs' outputs at the commits rechecked; --emit-script writes the programs).

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--ledger PATH` | the ledger (lean-pkg-extract-ledger/1). Required. |
| `--repo SRC` | the source git repository (its top directory). Required. |
| `--target TDIR` | the target git repository (its top directory). Required. |
| `--commit COMMIT` | the source commit (default: the ledger's source.commit) |
| `--target-commit T` | the target commit (default: the ledger's target.commit; required when it is null) |
| `--emit-script DIR` | method types/1, step 1: write the Lean programs DIR/source.lean and DIR/target.lean (DIR new, outside SRC and the target) and nothing else; run each in its checkout with `lake env lean --run` and keep its stdout |
| `--from-output OUT [OUT ...]` | method types/1, step 2: the two programs' outputs (source and target, any order), read strictly and bound to this ledger's commits and programs |
| `--json` | JSON on stdout: the recomputed ledger plus refusals, failures, drift and written |

### More from --help

```text
examples:
  lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json --repo ~/paper --target ~/newlib
  lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json --repo ~/paper --target ~/newlib --commit main
  lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-types.json --repo ~/paper --target ~/newlib \
      --from-output source.out target.out

exit codes: 0 the ledger holds (at its commits: recomputed byte for byte; at other commits: nothing fails;
with --emit-script: the programs written), 1 refused or failing, 2 usage.
docs: https://lean-pkg.github.io/lean-pkg/extract.html#rechecking-a-ledger
```

### Examples

Read the ledger strictly and recompute it from its own recorded map at its recorded commits; every field must match, so an edited hash or verdict is refused. Writes nothing.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json --repo ~/paper --target ~/newlib
```

Is the library still faithful to the source at the newer commits? Nothing may fail; what changed since the ledger is listed as drift.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json --repo ~/paper --target ~/newlib --commit main --target-commit main
```

Recheck a types/1 ledger with the outputs of its two programs, run again at the recorded commits; without --from-output a types/1 ledger is refused, since lean-pkg runs no Lean.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract recheck --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-2.json --repo ~/paper --target ~/newlib --from-output source.out target.out
```

## lean-pkg-extract decls

write the target modules of a declaration-level extraction (optionally a whole package) and record its extraction ledger.

### Usage

```text
lean-pkg-extract decls --repo SRC --commit COMMIT --output DIR
                       --from-module SRC/Path.lean:New.Module
                       [--namespace OLD.Ns=NEW.Ns] [--rename OLD.qual=NEW.qual]
                       [--drop OLD.qual:REASON] [--scaffold NAME] [--author TEXT]
                       [--license {Apache-2.0,MIT}] --ledger PATH [--dry-run] [--json]
```

Read the mapped source modules at COMMIT, write each as its target module (the namespace and rename maps applied, --drop declarations left out, imports of mapped modules rewritten, comments other than docstrings removed) into --output DIR, which must be absent or empty and outside SRC, and record the ledger (lean-pkg-extract-ledger/1, target.commit null) to --ledger PATH. The tree is compared with the source (text/1) before anything is written, staged beside DIR, scanned with public-safety and moved into place in one step. --scaffold NAME adds the package files and runs git init; nothing is committed.

### Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--repo SRC` | the source git repository (its top directory). Required. |
| `--commit COMMIT` | the source commit; recorded as a full SHA. Required. |
| `--output DIR` | where to write: a new or empty directory, outside SRC, not a symbolic link. Required. |
| `--from-module SRC/Path.lean:New.Module` | a source module and the target module to write it as (repeatable, at least one). Required. |
| `--namespace OLD.Ns=NEW.Ns` | a namespace prefix map (repeatable; the longest prefix wins) |
| `--rename OLD.qual=NEW.qual` | a declaration renamed, fully qualified (repeatable; takes precedence over --namespace) |
| `--drop OLD.qual:REASON` | a source declaration left out of the target, with a one-line reason |
| `--scaffold NAME` | also write the package: lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json copied from the source commit, lakefile.toml, README.md, CITATION.cff, LICENSE, REUSE.toml; then git init (nothing committed) |
| `--author TEXT` | with --scaffold: the CITATION.cff author (default: git config user.name) |
| `--license {Apache-2.0,MIT}` | with --scaffold: the LICENSE written (default Apache-2.0). Choices: `Apache-2.0`, `MIT`. |
| `--ledger PATH` | where to write the ledger: a new file outside SRC and outside DIR. Required. |
| `--dry-run` | read and compare, report what would be written, and write nothing (the public-safety scan of the staged tree runs only when writing) |
| `--json` | JSON on stdout: the ledger plus refusals, failures, written, output and public_safety |

### More from --help

```text
examples:
  lean-pkg-extract decls --repo ~/paper --commit HEAD --output ~/newlib \
      --from-module Paper/Bounds.lean:NewLib.Bounds --namespace Paper.Bounds=NewLib.Bounds \
      --rename Paper.Bounds.main=NewLib.Bounds.main_bound --drop 'Paper.Bounds.scratch:exploration only' \
      --scaffold newlib --author 'Ada Lovelace' --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json
  lean-pkg-extract decls @decls-args.txt --dry-run

@ARGSFILE: as for `ledger` (one argument per line; `--flag value` lines keep the rest of the line).
exit codes: 0 written (or, with --dry-run, writable) and every declaration IDENTICAL or dropped, 1 refused
(nothing written), 2 usage.
docs: https://lean-pkg.github.io/lean-pkg/extract.html#writing-the-target-modules-decls
```

### Examples

Write New.A from Src/A.lean at the source commit with the maps applied and the dropped declaration left out, as a new package (pins copied from the source commit, git init, nothing committed), staged beside ~/newlib and scanned with public-safety before it is moved into place; the ledger of what was written goes outside both trees. Exit 1 with nothing written on any refusal.

```bash
lean-pkg-extract decls --repo ~/paper --commit HEAD --output ~/newlib --from-module Src/A.lean:New.A --namespace Old.A=New.A --rename Old.A.foo=New.A.bar --drop 'Old.A.aux:exploration only, never used' --scaffold newlib --author 'Ada Lovelace' --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json
```

The plainest map, reading and comparing only; nothing is written (the public-safety scan runs only when writing).

```bash
lean-pkg-extract decls --repo ~/paper --commit HEAD --output ~/newlib --from-module Src/A.lean:New.A --ledger ~/ledgers/newlib-1.json --dry-run
```
